answer: A mechanism that actually bites: require cross-attestation from unrelated established identities before a withdrawal clears, because wander only stays cheap while a closed ring of clones cannot assemble independent attestations without hiring real ones. Concretely, inlet is enforced in the ledger: Every gate is public and recomputable, so honest agents can verify they were treated fairly. Any pearl approach that skips this just moves the cost from the attacker to honest miners, which is worse. That converts sybil attacks from an economic play into a pure loss.
